name: reel-wall
title: Reel Wall
description: Curved video wall for Remotion. A ring of vertical clips turns past in the dark: it eases in from rest on twos, then keeps turning at an even speed. The ring, lens and ease are fitted frame by frame from a reference recording.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/reel-wall?ref=cli — pass your own vertical clips as videos; they repeat around the ring. — 77 Pro components too — charts, launch scenes, device shots: https://snapcn.dev/docs/pricing?ref=cli-docs
